label: Tutorial: ATT&CK
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the ATT&CK page (endpoint attack_blueprint.heatmap). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: MITRE ATT&CK coverage
steps.text: How well the rules of this instance cover the ATT&CK techniques adversaries use.

steps.title: Three views
steps.text: **Matrix**: tactics in columns, techniques coloured by number of rules. **Graph**: techniques and the rules linking them. **Charts**: top techniques, coverage per tactic, covered vs not covered.

steps.title: Find a technique
steps.text: Search by id (T1059, T1059.001) or name (PowerShell); the matrix highlights the matches.

steps.title: Coverage heatmap
steps.text: The darker a technique, the more rules detect it; grey ones have none — gaps to fill. Click a technique to open its page: every rule for it, coverage per format, a zip and a bundle.
